Book is 435L/600S (short-heavy); lowering the long entry bar deepens long-side conviction names only (rank > 0.45) and rebalances the book. Miller(1977): long side of PEAD under-exploited. Targets Ret >= 4.7% with balanced L/S >= 480/520.

10 ops. Mirror A/B of S2: threshold 0.50 -> 0.55 makes shorts deeper (bad news bleeds longer, Hong-Stein slow-diffusion). S2 vs S3 is a clean paired experiment on WHICH side of the news carries unpriced alpha. Winner's threshold enters B81 champion shell.

11 ops. quantile() on the FINAL dense score (NOT the raw sparse signal that killed B78 global rank): no-news stocks collapse to a stable tie at the bucket-median constant, so zero tie-jitter risk; gaussian driver compresses the middle 80% and expands the tails -> per-unit-position Returns jump. Direct attack on the Ret 4.20 -> 5.01% gap.

11 ops. group_scale re-normalizes each subindustry bucket's final score to [0,1]: low-variance buckets (subtle but consistent catalysts) stop being diluted by high-variance buckets, equalizing risk budget per micro-bucket. Report Direction-3, never tested. Watch CW: bucket amplification could concentrate book.

10 ops. hump() deadband on the D=0 Sharpe-king (d5WkjPmJ, 1.58/20.3%): a deadband suppresses MICRO position changes without the phase lag of decay smoothing (lag is what costs Sharpe on the D-curve). If hump cuts TO 20.3% -> ~13% while Sh stays ~1.57, fit reaches ~0.91 as a base for the Return attack. Hump NEVER tested in 79 batches.

10 ops. Op-neutral swap: inner ts_decay_linear(11) -> ts_decay_exp_window(11) (default factor). Exponential kernel puts relatively MORE weight on the newest 2-3 days while keeping the full 11d memory (B79 law respected) - a cheap single-kernel approximation of dual-frequency coupling: fast reaction + slow memory in one operator. Inner exp never tested (B62 tested exp OUTER only).

11 ops. Ret double-strike: flat rel gate (no sqrt, saves the op for quantile) zeroes routine-PR days AND quantile gaussianizes the tails. Two orthogonal Return levers (input cleaning + output spreading) in one slot; if S4 or S1 alone fails, their combination tests superadditivity.
